g.text: Figure 10 — UML Deployment diagram — packaged runtime and optional external nodes
R0/R1 reviewer packaging exposes one application container and one browser-facing port.
React is compiled before runtime and served from the executable JAR by embedded Tomcat.
PostgreSQL and the external provider activate only in later rings when configured.
TLS termination, ingress, load balancing, and public DNS remain deployment-profile concerns.
